elements.commentary: I have used that Bowl making machine when they demoed it at an arena. It is an interesting idea, however, it does not limit labor costs, and its ability to standardize portion control was good, but it spit ingredients all over the place every once in a while when the opening was partially jammed. They may have made improvements to that, but it was extremely complicated. One could argue that it it more complicated than a human! Just the fact that each cylinder needs to be removed, cleaned and sanitized, then reinstalled is an issue. You still need humans to do that, and cleaning is not our favorite thing to do, so I hope they build a cylinder cleaning machine, which is fool proof. The first time someone gets a foodborne illness from one of those improperly cleaned machines will hurt their brand. I think $3 billion raised should tell investors something... maintenance and upgrade costs are going to be tremendous. And people in the loop will always be a factor.
